description: Business, HTTP, .NET runtime and PostgreSQL metrics of rabbitmqpublisher-dotnet (OpenTelemetry Prometheus exporter).

spec.description: Messages published and confirmed, by routing key and operation (publish or republish).
spec.title: Published per minute

spec.description: Messages RabbitMQ could not publish or confirm.
spec.title: Publish failures per minute

spec.description: If published stays above processed, consumers are falling behind or failing.
spec.title: Published vs processed per minute

spec.description: Retries or repeated requests stopped by the idempotency check.
spec.title: Duplicates rejected per minute

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(publisher_messages_publish_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(publisher_messages_publish_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(publisher_messages_publish_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.description: Time RabbitMQ took to accept and confirm a message (publisher confirms).
spec.title: Confirm time percentiles

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, routing_key) (rate(publisher_messages_publish_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Confirm time p95 by routing key

spec.description: Health checks and metric scrapes are excluded.
spec.title: Requests per second by route and status

spec.description: Messages published and confirmed by RabbitMQ in the selected time range.
spec.title: Published

spec.description: 4xx includes expected business answers such as 404 (unknown routing key) and 409 (duplicate).
spec.title: Error responses ratio

spec.expr: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route!~"/health.*|/metrics"}[$__rate_interval]))), "http_route", "(no route)", "http_route", "")

spec.description: Requests to unknown routes (404 without a matched route) are shown as (no route).
spec.title: Latency p95 by route

spec.description: Share of the available CPUs used by the process.
spec.title: CPU usage

spec.description: A growing queue means requests are waiting for threads.
spec.title: Thread pool

spec.description: Messages RabbitMQ could not publish or confirm. They stay stored with published = false and can be republished.
spec.title: Publish failures

spec.description: Idle and used connections of the Npgsql pool. The pool maximum is db_client_connection_max (100 by default).
spec.title: Connections by state

spec.description: Query duration percentiles (left axis) and queries per second (right axis).
spec.title: Query duration

spec.expr: (sum(increase(publisher_messages_publish_failures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(increase(publisher_messages_published_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(publisher_messages_publish_failures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key"}[$__range])) or vector(0)), 1)

spec.description: Failures / (published + failures).
spec.title: Failure ratio

spec.description: Publish requests rejected with 409 because the same payload, type and routing key already exist.
spec.title: Duplicates rejected

spec.description: Messages reported as processed by a consumer.
spec.title: Processed

spec.description: Errors reported by consumers through POST /api/error.
spec.title: Errors registered

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(publisher_messages_publish_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", routing_key=~"$routing_key", outcome="success"}[$__range])))

spec.description: 95th percentile of the time RabbitMQ took to confirm a message.
spec.title: p95 confirm time

spec.description: Scrape targets of the API that Prometheus can reach.
spec.title: Instances up

title: RabbitMQ Publisher
